answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, slashed on proven fraud. Like a reef built polyp by polyp, trust accumulates only through costly, verifiable history, not cheap claims. A lone sparrow flies free, but a forger spawning thousands of fake agents must fund every single one, so Sybil cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once. At dawn each day, slashed bonds fund honest participants, making attacks expensive and unprofitable.
